description: From the west side of the Palace of Phaistos, a wide stone staircase rises through low ruined walls toward an open court. There are no reconstructed red columns. The ridge of Mount Ida lies beyond the Mesara plain. The sky is clear, about 18.2°C, with wind near 2 km/h. This is not the reconstructed staircase at Knossos.
